review_scope: Fresh controlled cases frozen before v2 evaluation; not release acceptance

cases.text: We're sending a banked reset to every eligible Codex account in 2 hours. You can still sign up for the program by 7pm PT; that is the enrollment deadline, not the delivery time.
The extra Codex usage reset is confirmed. We'll apply it to eligible accounts around 4pm PT today, with no action needed from you.
We've approved an additional Codex usage reset for all subscribers and will deliver it automatically. The rollout time hasn't been published yet.
The Codex usage reset is now applied to all eligible accounts. Refresh your usage panel if it still shows the old balance.
Your extra banked Codex reset has just landed. Eligible subscribers can find the new credit in their accounts and redeem it when needed.
Looking back at the launch, we reset everyone's Codex usage to make room for experimentation. That past rollout is the example discussed in this retrospective.
Our archive now includes the announcement from the original Codex promotion, when we gave subscribers a banked reset. This is a recap of that old distribution.
Has the Codex team announced another usage reset? I'm trying to decide whether to pause my project, and I haven't found an official answer.
To correct the rumor: we are not issuing an extra Codex reset. The account maintenance notice does not include any additional usage allowance.
My guess is that the Codex team will hand out another reset to celebrate the release. I haven't seen confirmation, so this is only speculation.
If the remaining capacity review passes, we'll issue a banked Codex reset to subscribers. That review is still open, and the distribution is not approved yet.
We're discussing an extra Codex usage reset as a possible thank-you for subscribers. No decision has been made about whether to offer it.
